material.commit_comment:
docs: close win-screen-podium-ratings

Row: win-screen-podium-ratings
Witness: 1793551709672-6674-d9a0badf3b279cf5
Status: resolved
material.description: Owner decision: a podium view of the heroes with performance ratings, like Dota. Architecture (orchestrator choice): a single engine-neutral score module under scenarios/moba computes each hero's performance from the match counters, normalised within the match, and maps it to a 1-10 rating and a letter grade; the top three heroes stand on the podium (first in the centre). Acceptance: the podium shows the three top-rated heroes with rating and grade; the formula is in one module with a gate check that computes it on a fixed fixture of counters; CI green on the pushed sha.

notes.note: Stage 0 REFERENCES: scoreboard.lua reference recorded. Stage 1c EDIT: match_stats.evaluate (per-minute counters normalised to the match peak, weights to points out of 100000, rating 1 to 10, A to F grade, ranking by points then seat), match_podium panel, gate check win-match-stats-rank in rust/gate/src/score_checks.rs registered in checks.rs. publish_on_origin refused a sequential same-file publish with merge_conflict, so the commit was rebuilt on origin tip through the Git Data API. Published 9629f6c4 on origin/main.
